name: gateway-homeassistant
description: Home Assistant gateway. Calls REST endpoints under <base>/api/services/<domain>/<service> with a long-lived access token. Stdlib-only.

commands.send: Call a service (positional: domain.service text) — sends notify by default
commands.call: Call any service with raw JSON payload (positional: domain.service json)
commands.status: Show whether the HA base URL / token are configured
